chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who doubted during the Obligatory Tawaaf. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should repeat [the Tawaaf] every time he doubts.' I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you! What about a doubt during the optional Tawaaf?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should build upon the lesser [number of circuits].'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for doubt during Hajj Tawaaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the jurisprudential principle of 'building upon the lesser' (ibna' ala al-ashadd) in cases of doubt during Tawaaf, distinguishing between the obligatory Hajj/Umrah circumambulation and voluntary acts. It reflects the Imami Shia methodology of resolving ritual uncertainty by defaulting to the minimum valid count for optional rites, while requiring full repetition for obligatory ones to ensure validity. This ruling underscores the precision required in Shia fiqh regarding the integrity of pillar acts (arkan) versus supplementary acts.
